title: Conditional kappa 0.001672716806120974: rank-seven T16 owner exchanges
body:
Conditional candidate kappa **0.001672716806120974**, **+0.001501590%** over PR1104 (0.001672691689152441). Eleven legal whole-helper exchanges followed by a 24-bin repacking improve the T16 owner map for the rank-seven helper-end word. The scalar word, widths, source-event times and T16 geometry remain unchanged from that parent.

Published as a draft, then passed the complete publication-package replay through the unchanged PR1104 strict verifier. All 69 admission controls, 12 bit controls, 15 controller mutations, six independent owner controls, both exact moment engines and all 47 outer inequalities pass. The finite witness changes 110 role placements; VALIDATION.json records local evidence. Hosted CI remains separate. The rank-seven native word was independently rebuilt through PR1090's pinned construction and complete native replay; it is the same word used by PR1104, not the old rank-eight-end supplier.

All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer and PR589 bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, global packing optimum or full Lean proof.

Credit AlexS/Scale PR1030; 1337isnot1337 PR1090 with Codex assistance; jeremykothe2 PR1104 and preceding packing work with credited AI assistance; FanPUYen PR858; PR1018 including rohanarun PR987; PR1005; NewBArch PR869; and the retained PR799/741/685/645/589 lineage. Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new material Apache-2.0.

This improves the historical PR1104 parent, but is below the subsequently observed PR1148 construction. No current-best claim is made.
